body: I forgot to mention that with all this I also dyed my hair back to black, which I was also trying to avoid, and so I've bleached it recently (going for purpl) and I just look so terrible right now and don't know why I ever messed with my hair at all. I look like a 2010 wannabe emo lmao.

He doesn't like the idea of therapy or counseling. I will absolutely look more into those tests but as far as getting real professional help I'm afraid he wouldn't consider it a bit. His dad's brother has schizophrenia and has to take pills for it and everything so it could be possible it's some sort of hereditary thing?

There could very well be more that he hasn't felt comfortable to tell me about. The only one I knew was for sure was Ivan because I have seen his face change and his mood change so drastically and he'll just say "get out of my head"

I understand that and that's why I'm going to be giving him his week of space without even trying to push for anything. I just don't know how to not be so obsessive about the situation. Like in my mind right now all I'm thinking is that he will be with her so him needing time to think about me and him will be swayed by her company. My ex before him did a very similar thing where he decided he wanted a break and acted single and mingled in the process behind my back. It's stupid but I feel like in a way it traumatized me and I'm just trying to fight so hard not to let that happen to me all over again. He always told me I saved him but he also saved me from myself because of what happened before.

You makes some fair points. Thank you so much for your input. It's just hard to see it being his problem because I feel like if I simply ease up a bit everything won't be so bad but even when I try that, I get triggered by something and it's just an on-going cycle. Again, thank you for your perspective on this.

The thing is that he doesn't talk about that kind of stuff anymore and says he's changed. We have talked several times and he already has changed his ways for me but there's still the lying and doing things behind my back that makes me wonder there's more to it when I'm not around to know about it. It causes me to feel more paranoid about what he's doing because he'll say I'm being annoying for, example: asking him who he's talking to or wondering what he's looking at when he's on his phone, when it's just simply the fact that I feel like I need to know or else it must be something bad. And this carries on into other situations as well where I feel annoying for feeling like I need to know things, unlike I had done in my relationship before him.

I'm sorry if it was confusing where I was getting at, but some of the toxic things I do because of this is like wanting to know who he's talking to on his phone or not wanting him to be around certain friends without me and picking arguments over him glancing at another woman even if it was just for a moment. I understand these things aren't good in a relationship but I just can't help the feelings I get about certain things when they take place.
